title: Quantower Connection Instructions
content:
Connect using the Topstep Dashboard by selecting TopstepX as your platform. This links your account to ProjectX data — a direct CME feed for faster, cleaner market data with 10:1 Micro to Mini contract conversions.
Quantower via TopstepX is available for the Trading Combine® and Express Funded Account® (XFA) only.
Before You Start
Log into TopstepX™ and sign all required platform and data agreements before launching Quantower. Skipping this step will cause a "Login Blocked" error.
No API access required — just your TopstepX™ credentials.
If prompted to install .NET Framework during setup, allow the installation.
Installing Quantower for the First Time
Download Quantower and click Extract when prompted. The platform launches with DX Feed by default — leave it.
Click Connections at the top of the platform.
Disconnect from DX Feed.
Select ProjectX from the available connections.
In the Server dropdown, choose TopstepX .
Enter your TopstepX™ credentials and log in.
Already Have Quantower Installed?
Open Quantower and click Connections .
Disconnect from any active connection.
Select ProjectX from the available connections.
In the Server dropdown, choose TopstepX .
Enter your TopstepX™ credentials and log in.
What's Included with Topstep Accounts
Topstep accounts include the Premium Feature Bundle for free:
DOM Surface
TPO Chart
Volume Analysis Tools
Charting (max 2 indicators per chart)
👉 Level 2 Data is required for full access to premium features.
Not included:
Market Replay
Strategy Manager
Strategy Runner
Trading Simulator
Please note: Additional features may require a paid Quantower license. View Quantower pricing here .
Getting Started Tips
How to place orders using Trading Panels
How to monitor and flatten positions using Portfolio Panels
FAQ: General Errors
Quantower Support
Contact Quantower support here or visit the Quantower online guide .

Connect using the Topstep Dashboard by selecting TopstepX as your platform. This links your account to ProjectX data — a direct CME feed for faster, cleaner market data with 10:1 Micro to Mini contract conversions.

Quantower via TopstepX is available for the Trading Combine® and Express Funded Account® (XFA) only.

Before You Start

  • Log into TopstepX™ and sign all required platform and data agreements before launching Quantower. Skipping this step will cause a "Login Blocked" error.

  • No API access required — just your TopstepX™ credentials.

  • If prompted to install .NET Framework during setup, allow the installation.

Installing Quantower for the First Time

  1. Download Quantower and click Extract when prompted. The platform launches with DX Feed by default — leave it.

  2. Click Connections at the top of the platform.

  3. Disconnect from DX Feed.

  4. Select ProjectX from the available connections.

  5. In the Server dropdown, choose TopstepX.

  6. Enter your TopstepX™ credentials and log in.

Already Have Quantower Installed?

  1. Open Quantower and click Connections.

  2. Disconnect from any active connection.

  3. Select ProjectX from the available connections.

  4. In the Server dropdown, choose TopstepX.

  5. Enter your TopstepX™ credentials and log in.
